"""Check every full-suite input against the actual immutable Nix derivation source."""
import gzip,hashlib,json,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path('/home/josh/projects/klem');sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'tools'))
from copula_expectation_production import read,sha
OUT=Path('/tmp/klem-reported-deoni-package-sources.json');assert not OUT.exists()
receipt=read('/tmp/klem-reported-deoni-package-nix.json');assert receipt['state']=='passed' and receipt['snapshot_unchanged'] and receipt['exit_code']==0
package=next(p for p in receipt['outputs'] if (Path(p)/'bin/klem').is_file())
derivation=subprocess.check_output(['nix-store','--query','--deriver',package],text=True).strip();assert derivation.endswith('.drv')
command=['nix','derivation','show','--offline',derivation]
raw=subprocess.check_output(command,text=True);data=json.loads(raw);assert set(data)=={derivation}
assert data[derivation]['outputs']['out']['path']==package
source=Path(data[derivation]['env']['src']);assert source.is_dir()
archive=read('docs/reported-deoni-main-rust-sources.json.gz');rust=read('docs/reported-deoni-main-rust.json');formatting=read('docs/reported-deoni-main-formatting.json')
assert archive['rust_receipt_sha256']==sha(ROOT/'docs/reported-deoni-main-rust.json')
assert set(archive['files'])==set(rust['frozen_inputs']) and len(archive['files'])==661
old='#[path = "deoniman_support/parent.rs"]\nmod deoniman_parent;\n#[path = "copula_expectation_support/parent.rs"]\nmod copula_expectation_parent;'
new='#[path = "copula_expectation_support/parent.rs"]\nmod copula_expectation_parent;\n#[path = "deoniman_support/parent.rs"]\nmod deoniman_parent;'
assert set(formatting['files'])=={'tests/counterfactual_ryeon.rs','tests/degree_rimankeum.rs'}
files={}
for name,entry in archive['files'].items():
 text=entry['text'];before=hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest();assert before==entry['sha256']==rust['frozen_inputs'][name]
 if name in formatting['files']:
  record=formatting['files'][name];assert before==record['before_sha256'] and text.count(old)==1
  text=text.replace(old,new);assert hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest()==record['after_sha256']
 actual=(source/name).read_bytes();assert actual==text.encode(),name
 files[name]={'sha256':hashlib.sha256(actual).hexdigest(),'bytes':len(actual),'full_rust_input_sha256':before,'formatting_only':name in formatting['files']}
assert all(sha(ROOT/name)==entry['sha256'] for name,entry in files.items())
producer=Path(__file__)
report={'schema_version':1,'package':package,'derivation':derivation,'source':str(source),'command':command,'derivation_json_text':raw,'derivation_json_sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw.encode()).hexdigest(),'derivation_json':data,'files':files,'package_receipt_sha256':sha('/tmp/klem-reported-deoni-package-nix.json'),'full_rust_archive_sha256':sha(ROOT/'docs/reported-deoni-main-rust-sources.json.gz'),'formatting_receipt_sha256':sha(ROOT/'docs/reported-deoni-main-formatting.json'),'producer':{'text':producer.read_text(),'sha256':sha(producer)},'scope':'Every661 recorded full-suite input independently matches the actual immutable package source, with only the two exact recorded module-declaration orderings applied. No current-tree source assumed to be packaged without this comparison.'}
OUT.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n');print('Verified actual Nix source closure for',len(files),'full-suite inputs, including only two recorded formatting changes.',flush=True)

scope: Every661 recorded full-suite input independently matches the actual immutable package source, with only the two exact recorded module-declaration orderings applied. No current-tree source assumed to be packaged without this comparison.
